questions.q: What is a lockbox in the context of Receivables?
options: A secure vault for storing customer contracts
A bank-managed P.O. box where customers mail payments, with the bank depositing funds and sending a data file
A feature that locks a customer's account after a missed payment
A password-protected area of the Receivables work area
questions.explain: A lockbox is a bank-operated mail processing service: customers mail checks there, the bank deposits them, and transmits a data file of the payments received.

questions.q: What are the three stages of AutoLockbox processing, in order?
options: Validate, import, post
Post, validate, import
Import, validate, post
Approve, remit, clear
questions.explain: AutoLockbox first imports the bank file into an interface table, validates the data for consistency, and then posts receipts and applies them where possible.

questions.q: Which of these is a typical validation check performed during lockbox processing?
options: Confirming the customer's credit score with a third party
Checking that the transmission record count and total amount match the file's claimed totals
Verifying the customer's physical mailing address
Running a tax calculation on each receipt
questions.explain: Lockbox validation checks that the transmission's claimed record count and total amount match the actual receipts, among other consistency checks.

questions.q: What happens when a receipt in a lockbox batch fails validation (for example, an unrecognized invoice number)?
options: The entire batch, including valid receipts, is discarded
The money is returned to the customer automatically
The problem receipt is flagged for manual review while valid receipts in the batch proceed
Receivables automatically creates a new customer record to match it
questions.explain: Lockbox does not silently drop money or discard a whole batch — problem receipts are flagged for manual research while the rest of the batch posts normally.

questions.q: Why is lockbox considered one of the highest-volume receipt entry methods?
options: Because it is required by law for all businesses
Because it eliminates the need for any bank account at all
Because it replaces the need for a General Ledger
Because it automates the bulk processing of mailed checks, cutting manual data entry significantly
questions.explain: Lockbox automates the handling of large volumes of mailed checks, dramatically reducing the manual entry burden compared to keying each check individually.
